status: frozen before implementation; feasibility probe only
measurement_correction: Require pinned worker identity, successful spawn and SIGKILL/reap receipts. Prior runs without these receipts are insufficient evidence.
scope: Explicitly opted-in isolated completion; ordinary stateful Bash providers remain synchronous and unchanged.

cancellation.measurement: Input write through observable Readline line capture, including worker termination and reaping

proposed_product_bounds.process_scope: Direct worker count is enforced. Eligibility must forbid detached descendants. Arbitrary subprocess-tree counts are not bounded by a process group; this remains a design gate.

required_before_product_qualification: complete NUL-delimited output only; reject truncation, errors and overflow without partial insertion
cancel on input, context change, deadline, signal, disable and teardown
ordinary providers preserve globals, arrays, cwd, aliases and return-124 retry
no stale insertion after line, cursor, directory or generation changes
repeated cleanup evidence including children, descendants, descriptors and zombies
argument privacy and explicit environment/context contract
matching Bash 5.2 and 5.3 native and fallback gates
exclusions: This probe does not qualify the product capability.
These synthetic delays are not either of the two new 25 percent workload targets.
Universal stateful-provider responsiveness remains a separate open gate.
